name: blocksdk
headline: salesforce content builder sdk
short_description: The Block SDK for Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Builder simplifies third-party block development. It provides domain validation and simple method calls for cross-document messaging. Marketing teams and developers can use it to create custom blocks that integrate with Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
author: salesforce-marketingcloud

sections.overview:
The Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Builder Block SDK simplifies third-party block development by providing domain validation and wrapped cross-document messaging methods. It supports both script tag and Node module installation, enabling developers to create custom blocks that integrate seamlessly with Marketing Cloud's editor. The SDK offers methods for managing block content, metadata, and editor width, as well as authentication flows via SSO and OAuth2. Marketing teams and developers use it to extend Content Builder functionality with custom blocks tailored to their specific workflows and integrations.
Create custom content blocks that integrate with third-party services in Marketing Cloud
Build authentication-enabled blocks using SSO or OAuth2
Develop blocks that manage dynamic content and metadata for email campaigns
Design specialized block editors with custom tabs and configurable widths
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/salesforce-marketingcloud/blocksdk`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
